description.value: Anar Food and Grocery is a family-run Persian grocery market and takeaway restaurant that has been operating in Victoria since 2014. The store carries a broad selection of Middle Eastern and Persian pantry staples — dried fruits, nuts, fresh dates, olive oil, and specialty ingredients — alongside a deli counter stocked with house-made dips and spreads. The attached takeaway kitchen turns out authentic Persian dishes such as kebabs and slow-cooked stews, with third-party delivery also available.
